newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Land & General in screen joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Land & General in screen joint venture.

text.p: Malaysia's Land & General Bhd, a Malaysian government investment arm and U.S.-based Amerasia Technology Inc have entered into a joint venture to make visual display screens in Malaysia.
Land & General said in a statement late on Tuesday that the venture would involve making super twisted nematic liquid crystal display screens in Malaysia, under Lang Display Technology Sdn Bhd.
The government investment arm involved in the deal is Khazanah Nasional Bhd. The screens allow computer displays to be read in sunlight, the statement said.

The exercise would involve the acquisition of U.S. firm Crystal Clear Technology L.P. by Land & General unit Technocraft Group Services Ltd for $20 million in cash. Crystal Clear owns the technology for the screens.
Technocraft would be purchased from Amerasia Technology Inc, also of the U.S.
The completion of the exercise would each give Land & General and Khazanah a 45 percent stake in Lang Display, while Amerasia would own 10 percent.
